decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is cheap to maintain and serves the firm's B2B shop clients, though platform version changes may force a rewrite or retirement.
The ERP interface creates strong client lock-in and supports the firm's multichannel direction, so it is worth keeping updated.
Price comparison tracking still supports measurable marketing, but overlapping variants and platform migrations make consolidation plausible.
As the most redundant of the remaining tracking variants, its resources are better spent on new multichannel development, following the earlier withdrawal of Product D.
Net price reporting complements the display plugin for B2B clients at minimal cost, though it could be folded into Product A.
